_authoring.purpose: AI descriptions of a Milk Maid's milk reserves and fullness events.
_authoring.player_controls: How fullness feels and how characters react to it.
_authoring.contains: Full/half-full reaction prompts, status fragments and retained legacy text.
_authoring.perspective: The named Milk Maid owns the milk state; fullness narration leaves speaker selection to Skyrim.Net.
_authoring.boundary: Does not set capacity, fill breasts or enable leaking.

_help: Edit template text or replace a template with a string array. Keep the documented placeholders. Use MCM Reload Narration JSON after saving.

_authoring.format: Narration. Background or event context used by AI-generated narration.
_authoring.intent: Retained legacy wording for a half-full milestone; its old publisher is now a no-op.

build_milk_status_1.template: {actor} полностью полон, восхитительно тяжел и наслаждается наслаждением до оргазма. Ее руки скованы, и она не может свободно прикасаться к своей тяжелой от молока груди или облегчить ее, превращая ее полноту в продолжительное эротическое поддразнивание и ласку, которая ей нравится.

_authoring.format: Narration. Background or event context used by AI-generated narration.
_authoring.intent: Give the AI erotic flavor about the named Milk Maid being full with restrained arms.
